title: Astro Portal API v1 sign-in by e-mail code
description: Bodies of POST /v1/sign-in/code, POST /v1/sign-in/verify and GET /v1/space, answered only by a service whose GET /v1/service announces `signIn.method: email-code`; any other service answers 404 `not_found`. Requests: unknown fields are ignored by the service. Responses: clients ignore fields they do not know. See v1.md, section « Sign-in by e-mail code ».

language.description: The language of the message. Absent or unknown: `en`.

email.description: An e-mail address as typed. The service gives it one form (v1.md « Requesting a code »): composed Unicode (NFC); spaces, tabs, line breaks, no-break and ideographic spaces removed; any other control or formatting character (U+0000–U+001F, U+007F, U+200B–U+200F, U+202A–U+202E, U+2060–U+206F, U+FEFF) refused; the local part ASCII « dot-atom », 64 characters at most, lowercased (dots and `+` stay); the domain in punycode, lowercase, without its final dot, with two labels or more, the last not all digits; 254 characters at most. Otherwise the answer is 400 `email_invalid`.

normalizedEmail.description: The one form of an address, as the service writes it.

code.description: Six digits. The service ignores spaces and hyphens around and between them.

linkToken.description: The opaque token of the link of the message (32 random bytes, base64url, no padding).

deviceToken.description: The device bearer credential, returned once; only its SHA-256 is kept. Sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.

deviceProof.description: Optional proof that the device is genuine, issued by its platform: the kind of the proof and its token. A server whose rules rest on such a proof verifies the kinds it knows; any other kind, and a proof that cannot be verified, is ignored and never stops a sign-in. A private server reads none.

device.description: The application signing in. `installationId` is an identifier of the application's own, generated once and kept in the keychain (iOS) or the equivalent protected store, so that the same phone is recognised after a reinstallation. `name` is the name shown in « Mes appareils », by default the model of the phone. `application: sync` is Astro Sync: it signs in the same way and may be signed in to several spaces.

codeRequest.description: POST /v1/sign-in/code. The answer is the same whether the address already has a space or not.

codeRequestAccepted.description: 202 of POST /v1/sign-in/code: a message is on its way. Any earlier code of this address stops being valid.

verifyWithLinkForApp.description: The link of a message, used by the application only while it has a request in progress on this device, with the address the person typed there; otherwise it ignores the token and opens its sign-in screen. A token that does not belong to `email` is refused (400 `sign_in_code_incorrect`) and counted as a failed attempt for `email`.

verifyRequest.description: POST /v1/sign-in/verify: an address with its code, or an address with the token of the link — never a code and a token together.

webUrl.description: The address of the space on the web, where one signs in with the same e-mail address.

demoModeAllowed.description: Present, and true, only for a space the service's configuration allows a demo mode for: the application then offers its demo mode. Absent for every other space; an application reads absent as false.

verifiedForApp.description: 200 of POST /v1/sign-in/verify with `client: app`. `created` is true when this verification created the space.

verifiedForWeb.description: 200 of POST /v1/sign-in/verify with `client: web`; the response also sets the web session's cookies: `__Host-astro_portal_session` (HttpOnly) and `__Host-astro_portal_csrf` when they are `Secure`, `astro_portal_session` and `astro_portal_csrf` over plain http in development.

currentSpace.description: 200 of GET /v1/space: the space of the credential. `device` is the calling device for a bearer, null for a web session.

error.description: The v1 error envelope. `attemptsRemaining` comes with `sign_in_code_incorrect`; `retryAt` (also sent as `Retry-After`, in seconds) with `sign_in_locked`, `sign_in_rate_limited`, `service_starting`, and `sign_in_unavailable` when the e-mail budget of the service is spent.

bootstrapPath.description: With `not_initialized`: the web page where the owner installs the private server.

linkFragment.description: The fragment of the link of the message, `https://<service>/auth/link#v=1&token=<linkToken>&code=<code>&expires=<date-time>&lang=<language>`, read as URL-encoded pairs. The fragment never reaches the service: a visit to the link (a mail scanner) sends nothing and consumes nothing.
